title: SNP Calling of Apostichopus japonicus Color-Variants Genome
author: Jihoon Jo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gmbbu2n
materials: Realign the reads from assembled genome using BWA.

steps.title: Process Aligned Reads
steps.instruction: Group the aligned reads and mark/remove duplicate reads using Picard.

steps.title: Realign Reads with Indels
steps.instruction: Realign the reads with indels using GATK RealignerTargetCreator and IndelRealigner.

steps.title: Call SNPs and Indels
steps.instruction: Call SNPs and indels from the resulting sequence using GATK Haplotypecaller.

steps.title: Measure Nucleotide Diversity
steps.instruction: Measure nucleotide diversity in the genome using VCFtools with sliding window analysis.
